summary: Section 7 of the Fachprüfungsordnung of 22 January 2025 (study plan header PO-2025, in force from winter semester 2025/26; eCampus labels the same regulations 2024): 117 ECTS compulsory modules including the thesis, one of two 9-ECTS modules in Chemie und Nachhaltigkeit, 25 ECTS in chemistry specializations, one of two 8-ECTS practical modules (Berufspraktikum or Grundpraktikum Forschung, not offered this semester), 12 ECTS interdisciplinary extensions, and 9 ECTS additive key competencies of which at least 6 are in sustainability and 0 to 3 are in the other key-competency area.

categories.name: Chemistry and sustainability
categories.note: Choose one of the two modules in this area (9 ECTS).

categories.name: Chemistry specializations
categories.note: Take modules from this area totaling 25 ECTS.

categories.name: Interdisciplinary extensions
categories.note: Take modules from this area totaling 12 ECTS.

categories.name: Key competencies: sustainability
categories.note: Take 6 to 9 ECTS in sustainability. Additive key competencies total 9 ECTS, at least 6 of them in this area.

categories.name: Additive key competencies
categories.note: Take 0 to 3 ECTS here so additive key competencies total 9 ECTS. Skip this area when a 9-ECTS sustainability module already fills the 9.
